title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Firewall state' is set to 'On (recommended)'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall...\Private Profile\Firewall state to 'On (recommended)'
reason: If the firewall is turned off all traffic will be able to access the system and an attacker may be more easily able to remotely exploit a weakness in a network service.

title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Inbound connections' is set to 'Block (default)'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Windows Defender Firewall...\Private Profile\Inbound connections to 'Block (default)'
reason: If the firewall allows all traffic to access the system then an attacker may be more easily able to remotely exploit a weakness in a network service.
